headline: Eight seats open on the city's African Descent Advisory Committee
dek: Volunteers advise Regional Council on how municipal policies, programs and services affect People of African Descent.

facts.v: Second Thursday of each month, 6 to 8 p.m., on Zoom or at 60 Alderney Drive

body: The municipality is recruiting volunteers for its African Descent Advisory Committee, which advises Regional Council through the Executive Standing Committee.

Eight roles are open: a recent immigrant of African descent, a representative from Dartmouth, a youth representative aged 15 to 24, and representatives from the historic African Nova Scotian communities of Africville, Beechville, Lake Loon/Cherry Brook, North Preston and Upper Hammonds Plains.
The five community seats are vacant now and may start before May 2027.
means: The release doesn't give an application deadline. Check halifax.ca/serve for details and to apply.
